skills.summary: Teach-back check that finds your gaps
skills.job: Have the user explain a topic in simple words, then find the gaps and fuzzy spots in their explanation.
triggers: let me explain it back to you
gotchas: Fixing the explanation instead of letting the user fix it
Correcting every small slip at once

skills.summary: Plan review dates for what you learn
skills.job: Turn a list of topics or cards into a dated review schedule with growing intervals.
gotchas: Fixed intervals ignoring how hard each item was

skills.summary: Write graded practice problems with answers
skills.job: Create practice problems at rising difficulty for a topic, with worked answers kept separate.

skills.summary: Plan and run revision for an exam
skills.job: Turn the exam syllabus and date into a topic-weighted revision plan with mock questions and a final week routine.
triggers: help me prepare for my exam
I have an exam in two weeks

skills.summary: Set up a note system that fits you
skills.job: Choose and set up a note-taking method for the user's courses or work, with a template and a weekly review.
gotchas: Copying a fashionable system that does not fit

skills.summary: Read a hard text with the user
skills.job: Guide the user through a difficult text by section with questions, definitions and a final own-words summary.
triggers: I do not get this text
gotchas: Skipping the vocabulary the text depends on
Questions answered by quoting the text

skills.summary: Turn a topic into a mind map outline
skills.job: Organise a topic into a branching outline of main ideas, sub-ideas and links, ready for a mind map tool.
triggers: outline this topic as a map

skills.summary: Learn from a wrong answer
skills.job: Analyse a mistake the user made, find its type and root cause, and set a small drill to fix it.
triggers: why did I get this wrong
gotchas: Giving the right answer without the cause

skills.summary: Guide with questions, not answers
skills.job: Tutor through a problem by asking a sequence of questions that let the user reach the answer themselves.
gotchas: Questions that hide the answer in the wording
Pushing on after the user is stuck

skills.summary: Make a compact cheat sheet
skills.job: Condense a topic or course into one dense page of the formulas, rules and examples the user needs to recall.
gotchas: Including everything instead of what is forgotten

skills.summary: Clean up raw lecture notes
skills.job: Turn messy lecture notes or a transcript into structured notes with headings, definitions and open questions.
gotchas: Merging two topics into one section

skills.summary: Pick a course that fits your goal
skills.job: Compare courses and learning routes against the user's goal, level, time and budget, and recommend one.

skills.summary: Roadmap from beginner to a target skill
skills.job: Break a skill into stages with milestones, practice tasks and time estimates based on the user's current level.
triggers: how do I get good at
gotchas: Order set by topic list instead of dependency
Time estimates without the user's weekly hours

skills.summary: Learn a skill by building a project
skills.job: Design a small project that forces the user to practise a target skill, with milestones and checkpoints.
triggers: give me a project to learn
gotchas: Skills practised that were not the target

skills.summary: Build a memory palace for a list
skills.job: Create a memory palace route and vivid image links so the user can recall an ordered list.
gotchas: Images with no action or oddity
Using it for material that needs understanding

skills.summary: Give feedback on a student essay
skills.job: Review an essay for argument, structure, evidence and style, and give ranked feedback the writer can act on.
triggers: give me feedback on my essay
how can I improve this paper
gotchas: Rewriting the essay instead of teaching

skills.summary: Solve a maths problem with reasons
skills.job: Solve a maths problem in small checked steps, naming the rule used in each, and verify the result.
triggers: show me how to do this problem
gotchas: Skipping a step the learner needs
Giving the method without checking the answer

skills.summary: Explain an idea through an analogy
skills.job: Build an analogy from the learner's own world for a hard idea and state where the analogy breaks.
triggers: explain it with an example from everyday life
I need a way to picture this
gotchas: Analogy that teaches a wrong model
No mention of where it fails
Source domain the learner does not know

skills.summary: Build a glossary from your material
skills.job: Extract the key terms from a text or course and write a plain-language glossary with examples and links between terms.
gotchas: Definitions that use the term itself

skills.summary: Keep a short learning journal
skills.job: Set up and run a brief journal routine to record what was learned, what is unclear and what to practise next.
triggers: reflect on what I learned today
gotchas: No question for the next session
Journal that takes longer than the study
